1: func bubble_sort(data)
  1: block
    2: expr (a = list(data))
    3: expr (n = len(a))
    4: foreach(py ) i in range((n - 1))
      4: block
        5: foreach(py ) j in range(((n - 1) - i))
          5: block
            6: if (a[j] > a[(j + 1)])
              6: block
                7: expr (tuple[a[j], a[(j + 1)]] = tuple[a[(j + 1)], a[j]])
    8: return a
11: func insertion_sort(a)
  11: block
    12: foreach(py ) i in range(1, len(a))
      12: block
        13: expr (key = a[i])
        14: expr (j = (i - 1))
        15: while ((j >= 0) and (a[j] > key))
          15: block
            16: expr (a[(j + 1)] = a[j])
            17: expr (j -= 1)
        18: expr (a[(j + 1)] = key)
    19: return a
22: expr print(bubble_sort(list[5, 2, 9, 1, 7]))
23: expr print(insertion_sort(list[4, 3, 8, 1]))
